admin_totp_aktif_butuh_rahasia.name: admin_totp_aktif_butuh_rahasia
admin_totp_aktif_butuh_rahasia.value: totp_aktif_pada IS NULL OR (totp_rahasia_enc IS NOT NULL AND totp_kunci_versi IS NOT NULL)

akun_nama_panggilan_panjang.name: akun_nama_panggilan_panjang
akun_nama_panggilan_panjang.value: nama_panggilan IS NULL OR char_length(nama_panggilan) BETWEEN 1 AND 40

akun_dibekukan_alasan.name: akun_dibekukan_alasan
akun_dibekukan_alasan.value: status <> 'DIBEKUKAN' OR dibekukan_alasan IS NOT NULL

akun_hp_wajib_kecuali_anonim.name: akun_hp_wajib_kecuali_anonim
akun_hp_wajib_kecuali_anonim.value: nomor_hp_e164 IS NOT NULL OR dianonimkan_pada IS NOT NULL

alamat_lat.name: alamat_lat
alamat_lat.value: lat IS NULL OR lat BETWEEN -90 AND 90

alamat_lng.name: alamat_lng
alamat_lng.value: lng IS NULL OR lng BETWEEN -180 AND 180

otp_satu_hidup_uk.name: otp_satu_hidup_uk
otp_satu_hidup_uk.where: terpakai_pada IS NULL AND digantikan_pada IS NULL

otp_terpakai_sebelum_kedaluwarsa.name: otp_terpakai_sebelum_kedaluwarsa
otp_terpakai_sebelum_kedaluwarsa.value: terpakai_pada IS NULL OR terpakai_pada <= kedaluwarsa_pada

harga_level_mode_konsisten.name: harga_level_mode_konsisten
harga_level_mode_konsisten.value: (mode = 'PERSEN' AND harga_jual_rp IS NULL) OR (mode = 'RUPIAH' AND margin_persen IS NULL)

kategori_bukan_induk_sendiri.name: kategori_bukan_induk_sendiri
kategori_bukan_induk_sendiri.value: induk_id IS NULL OR induk_id <> id

timpaan_kedaluwarsa_idx.name: timpaan_kedaluwarsa_idx
timpaan_kedaluwarsa_idx.where: dicabut_pada IS NULL AND notifikasi_dikirim_pada IS NULL

satuan_jual_isi_kanonik.name: satuan_jual_isi_kanonik
satuan_jual_isi_kanonik.value: (jenis = 'PCS_1' AND isi_satuan_dasar = 1) OR (jenis = 'PCS_3' AND isi_satuan_dasar = 3) OR (jenis = 'LUSIN' AND isi_satuan_dasar = 12) OR jenis IN ('DUS', 'KOLI')

zona_aktif_butuh_drop_point.name: zona_aktif_butuh_drop_point
zona_aktif_butuh_drop_point.value: NOT aktif OR drop_point_pusat_id IS NOT NULL

tinjauan_ditutup_lengkap.name: tinjauan_ditutup_lengkap
tinjauan_ditutup_lengkap.value: status = 'TERBUKA' OR (selesai_pada IS NOT NULL AND ditangani_oleh IS NOT NULL AND catatan IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim(catatan)) > 0)

grup_ditahan_lengkap.name: grup_ditahan_lengkap
grup_ditahan_lengkap.value: status <> 'DITAHAN' OR (ditahan_pada IS NOT NULL AND alasan_status IS NOT NULL)

grup_batal_lengkap.name: grup_batal_lengkap
grup_batal_lengkap.value: status <> 'BATAL' OR dibatalkan_pada IS NOT NULL

grup_tagihan_terbit_konsisten.name: grup_tagihan_terbit_konsisten
grup_tagihan_terbit_konsisten.value: (status <> 'TAGIHAN_TERBIT' OR tagihan_diterbitkan_pada IS NOT NULL) AND (tagihan_diterbitkan_pada IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('DIBUKA', 'AKTIF'))

keranjang_grup_aktif_uk.name: keranjang_grup_aktif_uk
keranjang_grup_aktif_uk.where: grup_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'DITINGGALKAN'

keranjang_dipakai_grup_butuh_grup.name: keranjang_dipakai_grup_butuh_grup
keranjang_dipakai_grup_butuh_grup.value: status <> 'DIPAKAI_GRUP' OR grup_id IS NOT NULL

keranjang_siap_hanya_grup.name: keranjang_siap_hanya_grup
keranjang_siap_hanya_grup.value: siap_pada IS NULL OR grup_id IS NOT NULL

peserta_cara_kirim.name: peserta_cara_kirim
peserta_cara_kirim.value: cara_kirim IS NULL OR cara_kirim IN ('ANTAR_RUMAH', 'DROP_POINT')

peserta_tujuan_kirim_konsisten.name: peserta_tujuan_kirim_konsisten
peserta_tujuan_kirim_konsisten.value:
(cara_kirim IS NULL AND alamat_id IS NULL AND drop_point_id IS NULL)
        OR (cara_kirim = 'ANTAR_RUMAH' AND alamat_id IS NOT NULL AND drop_point_id IS NULL)
        OR (cara_kirim = 'DROP_POINT' AND drop_point_id IS NOT NULL AND alamat_id IS NULL)

peserta_level_harga.name: peserta_level_harga
peserta_level_harga.value: level_harga IS NULL OR level_harga IN ('SATUAN', 'MITRA_GROSIR', 'FRANCHISE')

peserta_dikeluarkan_lengkap.name: peserta_dikeluarkan_lengkap
peserta_dikeluarkan_lengkap.value: status <> 'DIKELUARKAN' OR dikeluarkan_pada IS NOT NULL

peserta_bukan_pengundang_sendiri.name: peserta_bukan_pengundang_sendiri
peserta_bukan_pengundang_sendiri.value: ref_pengundang_akun_id IS NULL OR ref_pengundang_akun_id <> akun_id

baris_level_harga.name: baris_level_harga
baris_level_harga.value: level_harga IS NULL OR level_harga IN ('SATUAN', 'MITRA_GROSIR', 'FRANCHISE')

baris_barang_lengkap.name: baris_barang_lengkap
baris_barang_lengkap.value: jenis <> 'BARANG' OR (satuan_jual_id IS NOT NULL AND level_harga IS NOT NULL AND harga_dibayar_rp IS NOT NULL AND modal_snapshot_rp IS NOT NULL AND versi_harga IS NOT NULL AND bebas_ppn IS NOT NULL)

baris_non_barang_tanpa_harga.name: baris_non_barang_tanpa_harga
baris_non_barang_tanpa_harga.value: jenis = 'BARANG' OR (satuan_jual_id IS NULL AND harga_dibayar_rp IS NULL AND modal_snapshot_rp IS NULL AND potongan_baris_rp = 0 AND subsidi_ongkir_baris_rp = 0 AND harga_final_rp IS NULL AND qty_teralokasi IS NULL)

baris_bersih_tidak_di_bawah_modal.name: baris_bersih_tidak_di_bawah_modal
baris_bersih_tidak_di_bawah_modal.value: jenis <> 'BARANG' OR harga_dibayar_rp * qty - potongan_baris_rp - subsidi_ongkir_baris_rp >= modal_snapshot_rp * qty

baris_nilai_konsisten.name: baris_nilai_konsisten
baris_nilai_konsisten.value: (jenis = 'BARANG' AND nilai_rp = harga_dibayar_rp * qty) OR (jenis IN ('DISKON', 'SUBSIDI_ONGKIR') AND nilai_rp < 0) OR (jenis IN ('BIAYA_ADMIN', 'BIAYA_ADMIN_PAGAR', 'ONGKIR') AND nilai_rp >= 0)

baris_ppn_nonneg.name: baris_ppn_nonneg
baris_ppn_nonneg.value: (ppn_baris_rp IS NULL OR ppn_baris_rp >= 0) AND (dpp_baris_rp IS NULL OR dpp_baris_rp >= 0)

baris_harga_final.name: baris_harga_final
baris_harga_final.value: harga_final_rp IS NULL OR (modal_cutoff_rp IS NOT NULL AND harga_final_rp > modal_cutoff_rp AND harga_final_rp <= harga_dibayar_rp)

baris_qty_teralokasi.name: baris_qty_teralokasi
baris_qty_teralokasi.value: qty_teralokasi IS NULL OR qty_teralokasi BETWEEN 0 AND qty

baris_bersih_final_tidak_di_bawah_modal.name: baris_bersih_final_tidak_di_bawah_modal
baris_bersih_final_tidak_di_bawah_modal.value: nilai_bersih_final_rp IS NULL OR (modal_cutoff_rp IS NOT NULL AND qty_teralokasi IS NOT NULL AND nilai_bersih_final_rp >= modal_cutoff_rp * qty_teralokasi + CASE WHEN qty_teralokasi > 0 THEN subsidi_ongkir_baris_rp ELSE 0 END)

baris_batal_beralasan.name: baris_batal_beralasan
baris_batal_beralasan.value: NOT dibatalkan OR dibatalkan_alasan IS NOT NULL

invoice_kedaluwarsa_ttl.name: invoice_kedaluwarsa_ttl
invoice_kedaluwarsa_ttl.value: gabungan OR kedaluwarsa_pada = diterbitkan_pada + make_interval(mins => ttl_menit)

invoice_komponen_nonneg.name: invoice_komponen_nonneg
invoice_komponen_nonneg.value: subtotal_barang_rp >= 0 AND potongan_rp >= 0 AND biaya_admin_rp >= 0 AND ongkir_rp >= 0 AND subsidi_ongkir_rp >= 0

invoice_ppn_nonneg.name: invoice_ppn_nonneg
invoice_ppn_nonneg.value: (ppn_rp IS NULL OR ppn_rp >= 0) AND (dpp_rp IS NULL OR dpp_rp >= 0)

invoice_total_konsisten.name: invoice_total_konsisten
invoice_total_konsisten.value: total_rp = subtotal_barang_rp - potongan_rp + biaya_admin_rp + ongkir_rp - subsidi_ongkir_rp AND total_rp >= 0

invoice_lunas_lengkap.name: invoice_lunas_lengkap
invoice_lunas_lengkap.value: status <> 'LUNAS' OR lunas_pada IS NOT NULL

ppn_tarif_rentang.name: ppn_tarif_rentang
ppn_tarif_rentang.value: tarif_persen IS NULL OR (tarif_persen >= 0 AND tarif_persen < 100)

ppn_dpp_konsisten.name: ppn_dpp_konsisten
ppn_dpp_konsisten.value: (dpp_pembilang IS NULL AND dpp_penyebut IS NULL) OR (dpp_pembilang > 0 AND dpp_penyebut > 0 AND dpp_pembilang <= dpp_penyebut)

pembayaran_lunas_lengkap.name: pembayaran_lunas_lengkap
pembayaran_lunas_lengkap.value: status <> 'LUNAS' OR paid_at_gateway IS NOT NULL

ledger_tanda_sesuai_jenis.name: ledger_tanda_sesuai_jenis
ledger_tanda_sesuai_jenis.value: (jenis IN ('SELISIH_HARGA', 'REFUND', 'REFUND_ONGKIR', 'BAYAR_TERLAMBAT', 'SALDO_BALIK', 'PENCAIRAN_BATAL') AND jumlah_rp > 0) OR (jenis IN ('PAKAI_CHECKOUT', 'PENCAIRAN') AND jumlah_rp < 0) OR jenis = 'KOREKSI_ADMIN'

ledger_koreksi_lengkap.name: ledger_koreksi_lengkap
ledger_koreksi_lengkap.value: jenis <> 'KOREKSI_ADMIN' OR (alasan IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim(alasan)) > 0 AND dibuat_oleh_admin_id IS NOT NULL)

ledger_four_eyes.name: ledger_four_eyes
ledger_four_eyes.value: disetujui_oleh_admin_id IS NULL OR disetujui_oleh_admin_id <> dibuat_oleh_admin_id

pencairan_four_eyes.name: pencairan_four_eyes
pencairan_four_eyes.value: disetujui_oleh IS NULL OR diproses_oleh IS NULL OR disetujui_oleh <> diproses_oleh

pencairan_disetujui_lengkap.name: pencairan_disetujui_lengkap
pencairan_disetujui_lengkap.value: status NOT IN ('DISETUJUI', 'DIPROSES', 'BERHASIL') OR disetujui_oleh IS NOT NULL

pencairan_diproses_lengkap.name: pencairan_diproses_lengkap
pencairan_diproses_lengkap.value: status NOT IN ('DIPROSES', 'BERHASIL') OR diproses_oleh IS NOT NULL

ambang_cod_nonneg.name: ambang_cod_nonneg
ambang_cod_nonneg.value: (min_pesanan_selesai IS NULL OR min_pesanan_selesai >= 0) AND (maks_penolakan IS NULL OR maks_penolakan >= 0) AND (maks_batal_setelah_kirim IS NULL OR maks_batal_setelah_kirim >= 0)

ambang_cod_persen.name: ambang_cod_persen
ambang_cod_persen.value: min_sukses_persen IS NULL OR min_sukses_persen BETWEEN 0 AND 100

armada_aktif_butuh_kapasitas.name: armada_aktif_butuh_kapasitas
armada_aktif_butuh_kapasitas.value: NOT aktif OR kapasitas_gram IS NOT NULL

diskon_nilai_sesuai_jenis.name: diskon_nilai_sesuai_jenis
diskon_nilai_sesuai_jenis.value:
(jenis = 'PERSEN' AND nilai_rp IS NULL AND (nilai_persen IS NULL OR (nilai_persen > 0 AND nilai_persen < 100)))
        OR (jenis = 'NOMINAL' AND nilai_persen IS NULL AND (nilai_rp IS NULL OR nilai_rp > 0))

diskon_cakupan_lengkap.name: diskon_cakupan_lengkap
diskon_cakupan_lengkap.value:
(cakupan_jenis = 'SEMUA' AND cardinality(cakupan_ids) = 0)
        OR (cakupan_jenis = 'LEVEL' AND level IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(cakupan_ids) = 0)
        OR (cakupan_jenis IN ('PRODUK', 'KATEGORI', 'ZONA') AND cardinality(cakupan_ids) > 0)

diskon_kuota.name: diskon_kuota
diskon_kuota.value: terpakai >= 0 AND (kuota IS NULL OR (kuota > 0 AND terpakai <= kuota))

diskon_level.name: diskon_level
diskon_level.value: level IS NULL OR level IN ('SATUAN', 'MITRA_GROSIR', 'FRANCHISE')

gratis_ongkir_subsidi_konsisten.name: gratis_ongkir_subsidi_konsisten
gratis_ongkir_subsidi_konsisten.value: (subsidi_jenis = 'PENUH' AND subsidi_maks_rp IS NULL) OR (subsidi_jenis = 'MAKS' AND (subsidi_maks_rp IS NULL OR subsidi_maks_rp > 0))

gratis_ongkir_aktif_lengkap.name: gratis_ongkir_aktif_lengkap
gratis_ongkir_aktif_lengkap.value: NOT aktif OR subsidi_jenis = 'PENUH' OR subsidi_maks_rp IS NOT NULL

gratis_ongkir_kuota.name: gratis_ongkir_kuota
gratis_ongkir_kuota.value: terpakai >= 0 AND (kuota IS NULL OR (kuota > 0 AND terpakai <= kuota))

gratis_ongkir_level.name: gratis_ongkir_level
gratis_ongkir_level.value: level IS NULL OR level IN ('SATUAN', 'MITRA_GROSIR', 'FRANCHISE')

kpi_cod_nonneg.name: kpi_cod_nonneg
kpi_cod_nonneg.value: pesanan_selesai >= 0 AND pesanan_total >= 0 AND penolakan >= 0 AND batal_setelah_kirim >= 0

kpi_cod_persen.name: kpi_cod_persen
kpi_cod_persen.value: sukses_persen IS NULL OR sukses_persen BETWEEN 0 AND 100

promo_satu_diskon_per_invoice_uk.name: promo_satu_diskon_per_invoice_uk
promo_satu_diskon_per_invoice_uk.where: aturan_diskon_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('DIRESERVASI', 'TERPAKAI')

promo_satu_gratis_ongkir_per_invoice_uk.name: promo_satu_gratis_ongkir_per_invoice_uk
promo_satu_gratis_ongkir_per_invoice_uk.where: aturan_gratis_ongkir_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('DIRESERVASI', 'TERPAKAI')

promo_tidak_memenuhi_beralasan.name: promo_tidak_memenuhi_beralasan
promo_tidak_memenuhi_beralasan.value: status <> 'TIDAK_MEMENUHI' OR (alasan_tidak_memenuhi IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim(alasan_tidak_memenuhi)) > 0)

status_cod_cabut_lengkap.name: status_cod_cabut_lengkap
status_cod_cabut_lengkap.value:
(dicabut_manual_pada IS NULL AND dicabut_oleh IS NULL AND alasan_cabut IS NULL)
        OR (dicabut_manual_pada IS NOT NULL AND dicabut_oleh IS NOT NULL AND alasan_cabut IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim(alasan_cabut)) > 0)

tarif_nonneg.name: tarif_nonneg
tarif_nonneg.value: (tarif_dasar_rp IS NULL OR tarif_dasar_rp >= 0) AND (tarif_per_kg_rp IS NULL OR tarif_per_kg_rp >= 0) AND (tarif_per_km_rp IS NULL OR tarif_per_km_rp >= 0)

job_berjalan_butuh_lease.name: job_berjalan_butuh_lease
job_berjalan_butuh_lease.value: status <> 'BERJALAN' OR lease_sampai IS NOT NULL

job_selesai_lengkap.name: job_selesai_lengkap
job_selesai_lengkap.value: status = 'BERJALAN' OR selesai_pada IS NOT NULL

outbox_terkirim_lengkap.name: outbox_terkirim_lengkap
outbox_terkirim_lengkap.value: status <> 'TERKIRIM' OR terkirim_pada IS NOT NULL
